title: Form Submissions
name: FormSubmissions
description: Keeps a copy of every message sent through a Form widget, with attachments, so you can read and export them in the admin even when an email goes missing.
author: ImpressPages community

options.label: Delete submissions after (days)
options.name: keepDays
options.note: 0 keeps them until you delete them. Keep only as long as you need, under your privacy policy.

options.label: Store the visitor's IP address
options.name: storeIp
options.note: Helps spot spam. It is personal data, so only turn it on if your privacy policy covers it.

options.label: Keep attachments
options.name: keepFiles
options.note: Files sent with a form are copied into the site's private files folder.
